info.title: Client Ledger API
info.description:
Admin-only API for managing clients and their earnings/expenses.

1. Call `POST /api/v1/auth/login` with admin credentials.
2. Click **Authorize** and paste the returned `token`.

Monetary amounts are decimal **strings** with 2 fractional digits. Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`.
